indicators.description: Fraction of completed API requests that do not return a server error.
indicators.interpretation: A decline identifies safe but unavailable request paths and is investigated by normalized route and stable error code.

indicators.description: The 95th percentile API request duration by normalized route.
indicators.interpretation: This is process-observed latency and excludes browser rendering and network transit.

indicators.description: Import outcomes, parser duration, parser memory, and quality findings using fixed labels.
indicators.interpretation: Adapter and quality labels are allowlisted and never include filenames, identifiers, or interval values.

indicators.description: Queue depth, oldest lease age, retries, and worker outcomes by fixed job kind.
indicators.interpretation: The worker runtime refreshes snapshots from the durable database before every polling cycle.

indicators.description: Scenario worker duration by fixed flexible-load count bucket.
indicators.interpretation: The workload bucket is derived from declared load count and contains no user-entered load details.

indicators.description: Solver terminal status and solver-only duration.
indicators.interpretation: The status labels distinguish optimal, best-found, invalid, and contract-failure outcomes.

indicators.description: Redacted report generation duration by fixed success or failure outcome.
indicators.interpretation: The metric covers report generation and persistence but never includes report content.

indicators.description: Deletion worker completion and failure counts.
indicators.interpretation: Any failure requires checking the durable job and separately protected ledger before retrying.

indicators.description: Request, durable job, worker, solver, result, and report spans share safe random correlation identifiers.
indicators.interpretation: Trace attributes are restricted to request IDs, job IDs, fixed versions, fixed statuses, and normalized routes.
